mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate for equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in less than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or the correlation between FEDFUNDS < 0.5% and positive returns is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL index level above 225.0 signals persistent inflation that triggers a monetary policy tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 225.0, or the correlation between CPIAUCSL > 225.0 and negative returns is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.1 percentage points and an increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 100,000 persons signals a robust labor market that accelerates corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in less than 40% of instances when UNRATE declines > 0.1pp and PAYEMS grows > 100k, or the joint effect is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 500,000 units, it indicates a weakening housing sector that reduces consumer confidence and spending, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in less than 40% of instances when HOUST < 500.0, or the correlation between HOUST < 500.0 and negative returns is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A declining industrial production index (INDPRO) signals a weakening manufacturing sector that reduces corporate profits, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 40% of instances when INDPRO is declining, or the correlation between INDPRO decline and negative returns is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When consumer spending (RSAFS) exceeds 380,000 million dollars, it signals strong household demand that boosts corporate revenues, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in less than 40% of instances when RSAFS > 380000.0, or the correlation between RSAFS > 380000.0 and positive returns is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in consumer spending (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) signals robust household activity that accelerates corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in less than 40% of instances when RSAFS grows > 50k and HOUST grows > 10k, or the joint effect is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During a period of monetary tightening (FEDFUNDS rising above 2.0%), the Fed's policy rate hike reduces liquidity and increases discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in less than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 2.0, or the correlation between FEDFUNDS > 2.0 and negative returns is not significant (p > 0.05).
